en: Black-and-white postcard view of a small wooden railway station building labeled "MULLSJÖ" beside multiple train tracks. The platform runs along the tracks with benches, telegraph poles, and a few people visible near the station entrance. Trees and low buildings line the tracks in the background. On the far right there is a board covered with advertisements. A small oval mark in the lower right corner reads "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI" indicating an authentic photograph postcard. The caption at the bottom left reads "Mullsjö. Järnvägsstationen."
